subject: Enablement timeline & procurement checklist — Brightline Health
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Jenkins <laura.jenkins@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + proposed enablement timeline (procurement items)

Hi Laura — great conversation today, thanks for the time. Per our call, I wanted to capture the procurement-related milestones we discussed and propose responsibilities and target dates so your procurement team has a clear path to vendor activation.

High-level objective: complete vendor setup and be invoice-ready by the start of pilot (target: 2027-06-15).

Proposed procurement milestones (draft):
- 1) Ariba/Coupa vendor request submitted — Responsible: Brightline procurement (procure@brightlinehealth.com) — Target: 2027-05-12
- 2) W-9 + Redwood finance form returned — Responsible: Redwood (Sergio / Sean will send) — Target: 2027-05-14
- 3) Banking details + vendor banking verification — Responsible: Brightline (finance) — Target: 2027-05-18
- 4) Vendor ID / PO setup confirmation from Ariba/Coupa — Responsible: Brightline procurement — Target: 2027-05-20
- 5) Final commercial sign-off & first invoice date agreed — Responsible: Brightline legal + Redwood sales — Target: 2027-05-25

Dependencies / notes:
- We need procurement contact for Ariba request (fillable doc attached).
- If Brightline requires a W-9 with a signature, we can send via DocuSign; pdf attached for your records.
- Banking verification can take 3–5 business days depending on bank; please flag if you need expedited verification.

Next steps from our side: Sean will attach the standard W-9 and banking template; I'll circulate a condensed MAP with milestone owners and a calendar invite for a quick procurement-sync next Tuesday (05/11).

If the dates look aggressive on your side, tell us which ones to slide and we'll adjust.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: Brightline_ARIBA_Request.docx (fillable), W9_Redwood_Inference.pdf (signed stub)

Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed enablement timeline (procurement items)

Thanks, Sergio — useful recap. Quick notes from procurement:

- We received the Ariba request doc. Procurement (procure@brightlinehealth.com) will submit the vendor registration by EOD tomorrow (05/11).
- For W-9, our policy is to have a signed copy on file. Can you send the completed W-9 via DocuSign or attach a signed PDF?
- Banking: we'll need the Banking_Instructions_Template completed by your finance team; our bank ops will then initiate micro-deposit verification.
- Legal has one small data-processing clause they want to confirm before commercial sign-off; I'll loop Legal if needed.

Also copying Mike O'Neil (Finance) who will own banking verification. Mike — can you confirm typical turnaround for vendor banking on your side?

Appreciate the speed — we remain on track for a mid-June pilot start but will confirm once vendor ID is provisioned.

Best,
Laura
VP, Strategic Partnerships | Brightline Health
laura.jenkins@brightlinehealth.com
